row.evidence: AdRoll's Single Sign-On (SSO) Integration article says "Single Sign-On (SSO) is included for all packages" (Advanced Package, Ads and legacy plans) and documents SCIM v2 at https://app.adroll.com/api/v1/scim with a Personal Access Token.
row.notes: New row. AdRoll (a NextRoll division) prices on media spend, not seats: Ads (self-service and managed) is pay-as-you-go and the Advanced Package is an annual commitment via Contact Sales; users are unlimited, so all per-user fields are null. The SSO integration (SAML v2 plus SCIM v2) is listed as included for every package, current and legacy, so SCIM is not taxed. SAML must be set up before SCIM, and setup goes through AdRoll's Customer Success team; only one IdP per organization. SCIM uses a generic endpoint (https://app.adroll.com/api/v1/scim, bearer = admin Personal Access Token) with userName, name, active and NextRoll extension attributes for role (user/admin), advertisable access and billing permission; no Groups. Removing or deactivating the user in the IdP deactivates the AdRoll user. JIT is explicitly not supported. Okta's catalogue has only an SWA AdRoll app and a third-party AdRoll connector by Aquera; Entra setup uses a non-gallery app. The public AdRoll API (organization, campaign, audience, ad, geotarget) has no user-management endpoints.

plans.name: Ads (Self-Service)
plans.notes: The SSO article lists 'Ads' without distinguishing self-service from managed; legacy packages (Marketing and Ads Plus, Starter, Growth, Essential) also include SSO.

plans.name: Ads (Managed Services)
plans.price_text: Pay-as-you-go advertising; managed services with qualifying ad spend (Contact Sales)

auth.token_source: Settings > Personal Access Tokens (created by an administrator of the AdRoll organization)

endpoints.notes: Only the base URL is documented; Groups, ServiceProviderConfig, Schemas etc. are not mentioned (null). No group attributes are listed.

operations.notes: Update is documented ('update ... email, name, permissions') without saying PUT or PATCH. group_push=false because only user attributes are supported ('Any other attribute is ignored').

deprovision.notes: Seats are unlimited, so seat freeing does not apply.

custom.how: NextRoll extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:nextroll:User with organizationRole (user|admin), advertisableEIDs (comma-separated) and billingAllowed; must be configured as custom schema extensions in the IdP

roles.how: organizationRole extension attribute (user or admin) plus advertisableEIDs and billingAllowed

limitations.text: SAML must be configured (with AdRoll's team) before SCIM.
Only one identity provider per organization.
Some IdPs deactivate and recreate the account on email change instead of updating it.

auth.notes: Personal Access Tokens, or OAuth for app integrations.

user_api.notes: available=false: the developer-portal sitemap lists the Organization (advertisables, pixels, rules), Campaign, Audience, Ad and Geotarget APIs only; users are managed in the UI or via SCIM.

okta.notes: OIN lists 'AdRoll' (SWA only) and 'AdRoll by Aquera' (SCIM, third party). AdRoll's own docs use Okta as an example IdP for its generic SAML+SCIM setup, so row idp.okta is via_generic.

entra.notes: AdRoll's Entra guide creates a non-gallery enterprise app for SAML and SCIM; no gallery app tutorial exists in the Entra SaaS index.

fallbacks.notes: Without SCIM, admins add users manually under Settings > Company > User Permissions.
